sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.359/2022 registered at Police Station Birlagram, Nagda, District Ujjain (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376(3), 511, 354, 354(a) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 3/4(2), 7/8 and 18 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 13/10/2022.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the trial Court has passed the judgment and applicant has been acquitted rendering the present bail application infructuous.
